blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Five graduates from Cebu-based schools placed among the Top 10 of the September 2026 Registered Electrical Engineers Licensure Examination, with one of them taking the No. 1 spot. Charles Anthony Saceda Santillan of Cebu Institute of Technology–University topped the examination with a rating of 94.25 percent, followed by Jeff Kepler Sombilon Teves of Cebu Technological University–Tuburan, who ranked second with 94 percent.
